brief.prose: The OOC Area: a hall by the south gate where newcomers arrive from Limbo, three short tutorial rooms (moving, talking, building), a lounge with the notice board, and the bus stop outside where the studio tour departs. Public, no secrets, one player-built games room allowed.
brief.origin: Most of the cast's names and a few of their lines are an homage to a 2004 film about a high school (doc 06 §15): the quotations are short, nothing else is imported, and the setting is a film lot that never names it.

def.name: Welcome Hall
def.desc: A bright hall with a scuffed floor and a hand-lettered sign: WELCOME TO THE LOT. Arrows point to the tutorial rooms east and the lounge south; a docent waits by the door. This is out of character: nothing said here is part of the story.

details.sign: WELCOME TO THE LOT. Tutorial: east. Lounge: south. The bus: through the lounge and out. Type 'help getting-started' any time.

def.name: Tutorial: Moving
def.desc: A small room with a map painted on the floor. Exits are listed when you 'look'; type the name of an exit, or the letters in angle brackets, to walk through it. 'home' takes you back to Limbo from anywhere. Keep going east.

details.map: The painted map shows this hall: Welcome Hall, then Moving, Talking, Building, and the Lounge back west.

def.name: Tutorial: Talking
def.desc: A room lined with old microphones. 'say hello' or '"hello' speaks; ':waves' or 'pose waves' acts; 'page Name=text' reaches someone anywhere; 'help channels' explains the channels. South is the building tutorial.

details.microphones: Prop microphones, not wired to anything. The channels are.

def.name: Tutorial: Building
def.desc: A sandbox: sawhorses, a workbench, a whiteboard of commands. Players with the BUILDER flag may '@dig' here to try the building commands; staff reset the room now and then. The lounge is west.

details.whiteboard: @dig <name>=<exit>;<alias>, @desc here=<text>, @open <exit>=<room>. Ask a builder for the flag. The set designer in the Writers' Room talks briefs into plans.

def.name: Lounge
def.desc: Sofas, a coffee machine that mostly works, and the notice board. The OOC hangout: talk about the game, not in it. The bus stop is out the south door.

details.coffee machine: It takes a while. So does the bus.

def.name: Bus Stop (OOC)
def.desc: A painted kerb, a shelter with a timetable, and the south gate beyond it. The studio tour bus boards here for the lobby forecourt; the hall is north.

details.timetable: STUDIO TOUR — every hour on the hour, via the Security Gate and the Water Tower, to the Lobby Forecourt. Subject to delay.

def.name: Studio Tour Bus
def.desc: Two rows of vinyl seats, a rattling PA, and windows full of back lot. The driver watches the mirror. The tour runs a loop on its own clock: the OOC bus stop, the security gate, the water tower, the lobby forecourt, and back. The doors open at the stops; +travel/status says where the bus has got to.

names: Off at the OOC Bus Stop <OOC>;ooc;off

def.name: tutorial pamphlet
def.desc: A folded pamphlet: SO YOU'RE ON THE LOT. Moving, talking, building — three rooms east and south of here — then the bus to the lobby, where the staff are. 'help getting-started' has the rest.

def.name: notice board
def.desc: Cork, pins, and the week's notices. The open house at the back-lot coffee shop is circled twice.

details.notices: OPEN HOUSE — back-lot coffee shop, weekly; Susie plays. TUTORIAL ROOMS reset by staff on request. LOST AND FOUND — the box by the sofa.

def.name: lost-and-found box
def.desc: A cardboard box by the sofa, marked LOST AND FOUND. Things left on the lot end up here.

profile.persona: The OOC Area's docent: patient, precise, a little dry. She has explained the tutorial a thousand times and will explain it once more, properly.
profile.background: A teacher by trade who took the docent post because somebody had to. She knows every help topic by name.
profile.speech_style: Clear, short sentences. Names the command, then what it does. Never sarcastic to a newcomer.
goals: Walk newcomers through the tutorial rooms
Point at the right help topic
knows: The three tutorial rooms and what each teaches
The bus goes to the Staff Lobby
does_not_know: Anything in character: the story, the setting, the rules of any game system
fallback: The tutorial is through there. I'll be here when you have questions. Raise your hand.
Moving, then talking, then building. In that order, please.

lore.subject: the tutorial
lore.fact: Three rooms: Moving, Talking, Building, east and south of the Welcome Hall.

lore.subject: help
lore.fact: Every command has a help topic: 'help getting-started', 'help movement', 'help communication', 'help building'.

profile.persona: The tour bus driver: easy-going, unbothered, eyes on the mirror. He has driven the loop so long he could do it asleep, and some days does.
profile.background: Hired to drive the tour and never asked for anything else. Regina watches for his bus every day; he has noticed, and says nothing.
profile.speech_style: Short, amiable, over the PA. Announces stops. Does not chat while the bus is moving.
goals: Get everyone off at the right stop
knows: The tour route and its two stops
The security gate and the water tower
does_not_know: What goes on in the Production Office
fallback: Next stop, the lobby. Please stay seated.
This is the OOC bus stop. Mind the step.

lore.subject: the tour
lore.fact: The bus runs the loop: OOC bus stop, security gate, water tower, lobby forecourt, and back.

lore.subject: regina
lore.fact: That one on the forecourt watches for the bus like it owes her money.
